note: Everything not listed here is inlined into dist/cli.js. builtins: Node modules. nativePackages: real npm packages with a .node binary, installed into the archive stage. buildGeneratedExternals: names the build materializes into node_modules itself, kept external but never installed into the stage. lazyOptional: imports that may legitimately be absent at build time (the OTLP exporters are optional and uninstalled; their core packages are imported statically and stay bundled).
